3a8f5a7d-8b5b-4f77-a2df-b0bb0bdb1b1e/Eve.en: On the song boat, the applause is deafening.<NL>The crowd surrounds <Character key=beauty str=Name />, showering <Character key=beauty str=GenderObject/> with adulation...<NL>Knowing that victory is out of reach, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> leaves the song boat...
